merchant/30420.htm.text: Trader Tyra: Hello there. I'm Tyra. I'm here by myself in the Dark Forest, but there are always adventurers like you coming through here ... still beats living in a crowded village. If you need anything, I can sell you a few supplies at good prices.

links.text: See the Lord and Tax Rate Information

Q00171_ActsOfEvil/30420-01.html.text: Trader Tyra: If you happen by Gludin, could you pass on a message to Trader Arodin? Tell him that unless the items arrive here by the agreed upon date, the Contract will be voided.

Q00171_ActsOfEvil/30420-02.html.text: Trader Tyra: Hmm, I ordered the mold over a month ago... This merchandise is a week late and it looks like it's been damaged. Regardless of whether the cargo was stolen or not, you're responsible for delivering the goods on time. However, it is true that Turek orcs are carrying out raids of unprece…

Q00171_ActsOfEvil/30420-03.html.text: Trader Tyra: Please take the bill I gave you to Trader Arodin. You will find him in the weapons shop in Gludin Village. Remind him that from now on he should keep the terms of our Contract.

Q00171_ActsOfEvil/30420-04.html.text: Trader Tyra: Arodin is OK, isn't he? I need to order something from him. Hopefully there won't be any more robberies!

Q00225_TestOfTheSearcher/30420-01.html.text: Trader Tyra: This Malrukian Wine is of the highest quality. It was made by distilling the spider's poison.
